labellers.C: openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro, blind tie-breaker on the 38 disputed judgments

rule: Take the fail/non-fail majority of {A, B, gold, C}; on a 2-2 tie C decides. The new verdict and label are C's.
blocking_policy: Blocking stays narrow: only the catalog blocking_rule blocks. The labellers' broader blocks are not imported; each corrected judgment's blocking flag was re-derived from the rule.
human_agreement: None of this is human agreement. HAR-97 L5 (human agreement) stays blocked until a human labels the gold.
